headlines.title: Aperam Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results
headlines.line: Aperam reported third-quarter 2026 financial results that fell short of analyst expectations, citing seasonal demand slowdowns in key markets, particularly in Europe.

summary:
**Market summary, session of 2026-11-05 (digest built 2026-11-06)**

U.S. equities fell sharply. The S&P 500 (SPY) dropped 4.41% and the Nasdaq 100 (QQQ) fell 6.49%, with the Technology sector (XLK) down 8.00%. The Russell 2000 (IWM) lost 4.59% and the Dow (DIA) 3.53%. Defensive sectors held up better: Consumer Staples (XLP) fell 0.75% and Utilities (XLU) 0.71%. Long Treasuries (TLT) rose 0.21%, gold (GLD) gained 0.81%, and oil (USO) rose 1.93%. The U.S. dollar index (UUP) was roughly flat at +0.07%.

Among eligible single stocks, AEHL (+178.2%), APP (+31.0%) and PTLO (+28.8%) led gainers, while CDLR (-71.4%) and VCYT (-54.3%) led losers.

Company news included Cloudflare reporting a Q3 beat and raising its FY26 outlook, though several analysts cut price targets. Microchip beat Q2 estimates but guided Q3 below forecasts. Koppers lowered FY26 EBITDA and EPS guidance after missing Q3 estimates. Aperam's third-quarter results fell short of expectations. Goldman Sachs cut its year-end 2026 gold forecast to $4,150 per ounce.
